quote: My room was smaller than I expected: a single bed, a narrow wardrobe, a wall-hung mirror with a hairline crack low on its glass, and a strip of floral wallpaper behind the wardrobe where someone had made a patch.
I slipped the locket into my pocket and, without thinking, wrote a quick line in my notebook: "11:07 — silver locket. E.L.",
The next morning I climbed up the narrow ladder to the attic with a torch and my notebook in my breast pocket. 9:14 a.m. — attic.
